cohort: The study included 225 cases of fetuses with prenatally diagnosed omphalocele from Amsterdam UMC.
finding: In cases of intended vaginal delivery for prenatally diagnosed omphaloceles, 76.7% of vaginal deliveries succeeded, with the majority not experiencing perinatal complications, suggesting it is a feasible option even with giant omphaloceles.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was successful in 76.7% of cases where it was pursued, with intrapartum sac rupture occurring in 13.0% of successful vaginal deliveries, which was not associated with the OC/AC ratio and was absent in cesarean sections.
